description:
Get the creator record of a coin: how many coins its creator launched before (launchesTotal, launchesAlive, launchesDead7d), what their wallets hold now and held at launch, events such as creator_sold and creator_exited with dates, bundled at open, paid promoters, and every label with its one-line definition. Where read, evidence lists the sites and accounts the coin's own metadata names (identityLinks, each with linksBack: true, false, or null when not checked yet), what it shares with other coins (sharedWith) and how many coins name the same site or account (namedOnCoins). Read from the chains by Chain Daddy. For a coin nobody registered with Chain Daddy, pass its token address as symbol: the answer also names the creator (creator, creatorSource); until a visitor's view of the coin has read its creator the state is pending, and unknown when the chain names no creator.

Params: chain (chain key, e.g. base, solana), symbol (a ticker, or a token address: a verified coin's answers as its ticker)
Returns: the record as JSON. state is first_launch, on_record, serial, blocked, pending or unknown.
Errors: NOT_AVAILABLE (no verified page for that ticker, a registered coin under a takedown, or the record is not available yet), API_ERROR

symbol.description: The coin's ticker, or the token address of a coin nobody registered

name: get_creator_record
title: Get a coin's creator record
